notice: These are provisional role signatures for benchmark auditing, not formally proved denotational semantics.

DO.gloss: An actor performs an action, optionally on an object.

IS.gloss: Attribute a property to a subject in the stated context.

HAS.gloss: A holder has an item; ownership is not necessarily implied.

CAUSE.gloss: A causal relation is asserted; not the same as mere correlation.

CHANGE.gloss: The property of a subject changes; no direction or amount is specified.

FLOW.gloss: The subject flows; no path or speed is specified.

IF.gloss: A conditional; does not itself assert the antecedent.

NOT.gloss: Negates the scope of the embedded claim.

AND.gloss: Conjunction of two expressions; not a temporal ordering.

COMPARE.gloss: Claims a comparison by a named relation, with its scale still provisional.

WANT.gloss: An agent wants a goal; does not imply the goal is achieved.

KNOW.gloss: Knowledge claim, conventionally factive; requires future semantic refinement.

BELIEVE.gloss: Reports a belief attribution, not proof of internal subjective experience.

SAY.gloss: A speaker makes a statement, not necessarily true.

REL.gloss: Open relation placeholder; may be too vague for precise reconstruction.

RAW.gloss: Escaped natural language, never counted as structured coverage.

PARTIAL.gloss: Benchmark-only annotation: structured core with unresolved meaning in RAW.
